exposure: Hospital-level median value of profits from cesarean deliveries
outcome: Probability of undergoing a cesarean delivery
cohort: Nationally representative sample of women at low risk for cesarean birth who delivered newborns between 2010 and 2014 in the US
finding: Pregnant women were more likely to have a cesarean birth when they delivered at hospitals with higher profits per procedure from cesarean deliveries.
mod_finding: Higher profits per cesarean procedure at the hospital level were associated with an increased probability of cesarean delivery.
